$comment: Canonical design tokens for Display Share. Command 1 of the UI/UX audit. Both apps generate from this file; nothing may hardcode a hex value in app code. Run design/generate.sh after editing, and commit the generated output — CI fails if it drifts.
$motionComment: Milliseconds, plus the cubic-bezier control points. Both apps decelerate on the same curve; the Mac previously used an ad-hoc easeOut and the receiver its own bezier, so the two products moved differently.
